title: Packet
description: One turn's full exchange with the provider: { system, user, assistant, assistantRaw }. system aggregates durable + accumulating context (definition, persona, in-scope log rows). user carries the per-turn ephemera. assistant is the provider-normalized output. assistantRaw is opaque.

tokens.description: Total packet tokens — sum of section subtotals.

system_definition.description: text/markdown — plurnk grammar + scheme registry refs.

prompt.description: Copy of loop.prompt — never null on a continuation turn.

telemetry.description: Per-turn instrumentation surfaced to the model. `budget` is renderer-provided markdown describing remaining context / cost / etc. `events` carries the cross-ecosystem error/telemetry stream (parser errors, scheme dispatch failures, engine rail signals, provider faults) — consumers route on each event's `source` + `kind` discriminator.

budget.description: text/markdown — budget surface (token/cost/etc. left to spend). Empty string when nothing to surface.

events.description: TelemetryEvent[]. Empty array when nothing to surface.

content.description: Raw DSL string emitted by the model.

reasoning.description: text/plain — provider-exposed CoT when present, null otherwise.
